narrative: Material PL1__M7EDFC42 exhibits smooth demand with CV=0.28. Mean daily demand is 2344.4 units with std=658.1. Lead time averages 1.36 days (stability: variable, CV=0.70). Recommended safety stock is 3889 units (vs SAP 2610), order quantity 18947 units (EOQ: 28674), reorder point 7070 units. Storage capacity constraint is respected (22836 <= 22836.276). Annual cost delta: +$236.68.

research_insights.selection_rationale: Smooth near-normal demand with highly variable lead times makes a stochastic reorder-point/fixed-order-quantity model the optimal fit; EOQ balances ordering vs holding costs while safety stock absorbs lead-time uncertainty at 95% service level.
research_insights.boundary_risk: HIGH — storage capacity constraint is binding at 22,836 units; any increase in safety stock would require a corresponding reduction in order quantity below the unconstrained EOQ, potentially increasing ordering frequency and cost.
research_insights.escalation_flag: SAP safety stock (2,610) is materially understated for observed lead-time volatility (CV=0.70); recommend raising to 3,889 and updating safety lead time from 2.0 to 3.01 days in ERP. Consider simulation-based validation given the binding capacity constraint.
